description: Inject project context at session start — current branch, Node/Python versions, recent commits

SessionStart.command: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const ctx={}; try{ctx.branch=execSync('git branch --show-current',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();}catch(e){ctx.branch='unknown';} try{ctx.node=execSync('node --version',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();}catch(e){} try{ctx.python=execSync('python --version',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();}catch(e){} try{ctx.recentCommits=execSync('git log --oneline -5',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim().split('\n');}catch(e){ctx.recentCommits=[];} try{ctx.status=execSync('git status --short',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();}catch(e){ctx.status='';} console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'SessionStart',additionalContext:'TeamReel project context: '+JSON.stringify(ctx)}}));"
